deploy-bot: Deploy started to *staging* by @jen — release: release/2026-03-18-rc3 — canary: 20% traffic — change window ends 2026-03-18T10:30:00Z
deploy-bot: Commits in this rollout (short SHA • author • PR):

- b9e8c11 • ashley • https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/479

jen: Canary routing in progress, watching latency and error rate. tagging me if anything noisy :eyes:
mike: FYI 4a7f3d2 touches the runtime KV cache path — please watch mem and gc metrics (pod memory + swap).
ashley: Also contains a model pin in config: model: redwood-embed-v1@v1.2.1 — that was intentional for perf tests.
sam: Seeing a few 500s from runtime-ingress tail 1m:```
ERROR runtime/kv_cache.go:152: panic: nil pointer deref
goroutine 42 [running]:
runtime...```
jen: pausing canary (20% -> 0%) — will rollback if errors > 0.5% for 5m. Starting investigation.
mike: Copy. Opening a quick smoke to reproduce locally.
jen: Smoke shows mem spike and same panic from runtime/kv_cache on sequential prefix fill.
ashley: That matches my change in batching heuristics + cache boundary checks, rolling back that commit seems safest.
sam: I agree — suggest rollback to previous stable tag release/2026-03-17 (sha d4c3b2a by marta) and pin Dedicated pool to that sha until a patch is out.
jen: +1 — execute rollback now.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by @jen: target tag release/2026-03-17 (d4c3b2a) — executing revert and redeploy to staging.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete — new active release at staging: release/2026-03-17 (d4c3b2a • marta) — deploy status: SUCCESS — duration: 2m37s.
jen: Canary redeployed to 20% on the stable tag, metrics look back to baseline. Thanks team.
mike: I'll open a revert PR for 4a7f3d2 and add extra nil checks + unit for KV cache.
ashley: I'll follow up with a smaller change to the batching heuristics and add an integration test to catch this.
sam: Filed incident ticket INC-2026-1122 and linked the failing log. Adding playback traces.
marta: Thanks for the quick rollback. Please also pin Dedicated -> d4c3b2a in deploy config until patch is released.
mike: Will do the Dedicated pin and notify infra-schedule for a controlled release window.
jen: Postmortem assigned to mike + ashley + sam. I'll draft release note/explainer for customers about brief staging flake.
deploy-bot: Notifications: CI rerun queued, oncall alerted, incident ticket updated: https://incident.redwood.ai/INC-2026-1122
jen: closing thread here, follow-ups in the postmortem doc. :lock:
